data.exact_reserve_text: The 2012, 2013 and 2014 years of account have all shown a profit, with syndicate 1200 being the only syndicate showing a loss. The incoming 2011 and 2012 years of account of RITC produced a technical surplus following continuing favourable incurred development at an attritional level in a number of classes as well as favourable developments on certain individual losses.

prior_year_events.event_name: 100% quota share reinsurance agreement with syndicate 1200
prior_year_events.impact_description: Entered into a 100% quota share reinsurance agreement with syndicate 1200 in respect of the majority of the reserves of the 2009 and prior underwriting years of account (transferring/reserving via quota share/RITC arrangements).

prior_year_events.event_name: 100% quota share ceded to Fitzwilliam (SAC) Insurance Limited in respect of RITC of syndicates 588 and 861
prior_year_events.impact_description: Syndicate ceded a 100% quota share in respect of the reinsurance to close of syndicates 588 and 861.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding decreased from GBP 348.328m at the opening of the year to GBP 308.138m at year end, a release of approximately GBP 40.19m (about 11.5% of opening reserves). The Managing Agent attributes prior-year improvement to continuing favourable incurred development at an attritional level across a number of classes and favourable developments on certain individual losses, and the syndicate also utilised quota share/RITC reinsurance arrangements (notably with syndicate 1200) which affected the composition of reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: continuing favourable incurred development at an attritional level in a number of classes
favourable developments on certain individual losses
entered into a 100% quota share reinsurance agreement with syndicate 1200 in respect of the majority of the reserves of the 2009 and prior underwriting years of account

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities: Claims outstanding) prior-year column. No explicit 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was found in the notes; prior-year development is inferred from the change in gross claims outstanding between opening and closing balances (release of GBP 40.19m). This may conflate current-year reserve movements and effects of quota-share/RITC arrangements; confidence moderate.
